paragraphs: We are a life sciences company transforming healthcare innovation by accelerating biomarker breakthroughs from discovery to diagnostics using our ultra-sensitive translational research and spatial biology instruments, consumables, and services. We continue to invest in pushing a paradigm shift in healthcare from an emphasis on later-stage treatment to a focus on earlier detection, monitoring, prognosis, and, ultimately, prevention. Our combined platforms have achieved significant commercial adoption with an installed base of over 2,500 instruments and scientific validation with citations in more than 6,200 scientific publications in areas of high unmet medical need and research interest such as neurology, oncology, immunology, and inflammation.

Our proprietary digital "Simoa" detection technology enables customers to reliably detect protein biomarkers at ultra-low concentrations in blood, serum and other fluids that, in many cases, are undetectable using conventional, analog immunoassay technologies. Multi-plexing biomarker analysis in tissue samples with our "Spatial Biology" platforms enables scientists to understand the localized interactions occurring on the cellular level. We believe our combination of technologies will enable scientists to help drive diagnostic innovation in the evolving healthcare landscape with data across the tissue to fluid continuum. Currently, the ability of our Simoa platforms to detect proteins in the femtomolar range is enabling the development of novel therapies and diagnostics and has the potential to identify early-stage disease markers before symptoms appear.

We sell our proprietary instruments and related consumables worldwide to research laboratories, contract research organizations ("CROs"), academic institutions, and bio-pharmaceutical companies. In addition, we provide contract research services and clinical laboratory testing services, including four Laboratory Developed Tests ("LDTs"), using our proprietary technology and platforms through our Accelerator Laboratory, which is certified under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 ("CLIA"), located in Bedford, Massachusetts (the "Accelerator Laboratory").

In the second half of 2025, four new directors joined our board of directors and four previous members of our board of directors departed, including Dr. David Walt, our founding scientist. Additionally, in January 2026 Dr. Masoud Toloue left the company, and Everett Cunningham became our Chief Executive Officer and joined our board of directors. The selection process for these new board members and our CEO reflects a deliberate enhancement of technology, commercial, spatial, and diagnostics expertise across our leadership and board of directors.

On July 8, 2025, we acquired Akoya Biosciences, Inc. ("Akoya"), a life sciences technology company based in Marlborough, Massachusetts delivering spatial biology solutions through the power of spatial phenotyping. Spatial phenotyping refers to a rapidly evolving technology that enables scientists to detect and map the distribution of cell types and biomarkers across whole tissue samples at single-cell resolution, enabling advancements in their understanding of disease progression and patient response to therapy. Akoya commercializes proprietary instrument platforms, reagents, software, and services that offer end-to-end solutions to perform tissue analysis and spatial phenotyping from discovery through translational and clinical research and diagnostics.

On January 8, 2025, we acquired Emission, Inc. ("Emission"), a life sciences manufacturing company based in Georgetown, Texas. Emission produces large-scale, highly-uniform dye-encapsulating magnetic beads designed for low and mid-plex assays and a mid-plex platform that reads its proprietary beads. The transaction secured the use of Emission's highly controlled beads in our next generation platforms and expansion into a new multi-plex segment targeting third-party original equipment manufacturer customers.

For further information about the Akoya and Emission acquisitions, refer to Note 3 - Acquisitions in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2025 included in the section titled, "Part II, Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplemental Data" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
On January 31, 2026, we submitted a 510(k) premarket notification to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") for our multi-analyte algorithmic blood test for Alzheimer's disease ("AD").

This submission represents a significant milestone in the Company's mission to provide superior, non-invasive, high-performance diagnostic tools to aid in the evaluation of patients with cognitive symptoms for possible Alzheimer's disease. Our multi-analyte test previously received Breakthrough Device Designation from the FDA, a program intended to accelerate the development and review of devices that provide for more effective treatment or diagnosis of life-threatening or irreversibly debilitating diseases. Our test, if cleared by the FDA, is intended to aid in identifying whether patients with cognitive symptoms are likely to have amyloid brain plaques—a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease —providing diagnostic clarity through a non-invasive blood test.

In November 2025, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services ("CMS") approved a reimbursement rate of $897 for our LucentAD Complete multiplex test. This milestone provides a nationally recognized reference price, an important step for coverage decisions with payers, enables broader access. and supports efforts to bring this multiplex diagnostic solution to hospitals and laboratories across the country. In addition, based on available data, we believe LucentAD Complete has the potential to obtain a Local Coverage Determination, which would support more consistent reimbursement of claims.

As previously disclosed, on August 4, 2025, we entered into a Cooperation Agreement (the "Cooperation Agreement") with Kent Lake PR LLC, the general partner of Kent Lake Partners LP (together, "Kent Lake"), pursuant to which we agreed to retain an executive search firm to identify a potential candidate to be appointed to our board of directors (the "Board"). We also agreed to cooperate with Kent Lake to select an individual from the executive search firm's list of six candidates and to appoint such person as a Class I director by December 1, 2025. On November 20, 2025, the Board appointed two new directors, including one new Class I director.

Also pursuant to the Cooperation Agreement, we sought and obtained stockholder approval at our 2025 annual meeting of stockholders of an amendment to our Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation that declassified the Board, and we amended our bylaws to adopt a majority voting standard for uncontested director elections, with a plurality voting standard for contested director elections.

In the Cooperation Agreement, Kent Lake agreed to abide by certain voting commitments, customary standstill obligations and mutual non-disparagement, and no litigation provisions until the date that is thirty days prior to the nomination deadline under the bylaws for the nomination of director candidates for election to the Board at the 2027 annual meeting of stockholders, unless the Cooperation Agreement is earlier terminated in accordance with its terms.

Proteins are versatile macromolecules that serve critical functions in nearly all biological processes. Proteins are analytes that are highly relevant physiologically, providing real-time pictures of disease, and researchers and clinicians rely extensively on protein biomarkers for use in research and as clinical and diagnostic tools. However, normal physiological levels of many proteins are not detectable in easily accessible blood samples using conventional, analog immunoassay technologies, and many of these technologies can only detect proteins once they have reached levels that reflect more advanced disease or injury. For many other low abundance proteins, these technologies cannot detect proteins even at disease- or injury-elevated levels.

headings: Risks Related to our Financial Condition and Financial Reporting Matters
We have incurred annual losses since our formation, and we expect to incur losses in the future. We cannot be certain that we will achieve or sustain profitability.
Inherent limitations associated with, our internal control over financial reporting could result in material misstatements in our financial statements.
Our ability to use net operating losses to offset future income may be subject to certain limitations.
We may fail to achieve the remaining expected cost savings and related benefits from our cost reduction actions, and the consequences of those actions may adversely impact our business.
If our products fail to achieve and sustain sufficient market acceptance, our revenue will be adversely affected.
We may not be successful in penetrating the diagnostics market.
The sales cycle for our instruments can be lengthy and variable, which makes it difficult for us to forecast revenue and other operating results.
Purchase of our instruments by our customers requires a significant capital investment which can impact sales in times of constrained spending.

Because a significant portion of our revenue comes from a few large customers, any significant decrease in sales to these customers, due to industry consolidation or otherwise, could harm our operating results.
Our long-term results depend upon our ability to improve existing products and introduce and market new products successfully and timely.

We may experience delays in launching and commercializing our next-generation instruments, on our anticipated timeline, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our reliance on distributors for sales of our products outside of the United States could impact our revenue.
We could be adversely affected by violations of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and other worldwide anti-bribery laws by us or our agents.
The life sciences research and diagnostic markets are highly competitive. If we fail to effectively compete, our business, financial condition and operating results will suffer.

Integrating any business, product or technology we acquire can be expensive and time-consuming and can disrupt and adversely affect our ongoing business, including product sales, and distract our management.
Risks Related to Government Regulation and Diagnostic Product Reimbursement
Our products may in the future be subject to product recalls that could harm our reputation, business and financial results.
paragraphs: The following risk factors and other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K should be carefully considered. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we presently deem less significant may also impair our business operations. Please see page ii of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of some of the forward-looking statements that are qualified by these risk factors. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future growth prospects could be materially and adversely affected.

•Our quarterly and annual operating results and cash flows have fluctuated in the past and might continue to fluctuate, which could cause the value of our common stock to fluctuate or decline significantly.
•We have incurred annual losses since we were formed and expect to incur losses in the future. We cannot be certain that we will achieve or sustain profitability.
•Inherent limitations associated with our internal control over financial reporting could result in material misstatements in our financial statements.

•Integrating our business with that of Akoya may be more difficult, costly or time-consuming than expected and we may fail to realize the remaining anticipated benefits of the acquisition, which may adversely affect our business results and negatively affect the value of our common stock.
•We may not achieve the remaining expected cost savings and related benefits from our cost reduction actions, and the consequences of those actions may adversely impact our business.

We are a life sciences company transforming healthcare innovation by accelerating biomarker breakthroughs from discovery to diagnostics using our ultra-sensitive translational research and spatial biology instruments, consumables, and services. We continue to invest in pushing a paradigm shift in healthcare from an emphasis on later-stage treatment to a focus on earlier detection, monitoring, prognosis, and, ultimately, prevention. Our combined platforms have achieved significant commercial adoption with an installed base of over 2,500 instruments and scientific validation with citations in more than 6,200 scientific publications in areas of high unmet medical need and research interest such as neurology, oncology, immunology, and inflammation.

Our proprietary digital "Simoa" detection technology enables customers to reliably detect protein biomarkers at ultra-low concentrations in blood, serum and other fluids that, in many cases, are undetectable using conventional, analog immunoassay technologies. Multi-plexing biomarker analysis in tissue samples with our "Spatial Biology" platforms enables scientists to understand the localized interactions occurring on the cellular level. We believe our combination of technologies will enable scientists to help drive diagnostic innovation in the evolving healthcare landscape with data across the tissue to fluid continuum. Currently, the ability of our Simoa platforms to detect proteins in the femtomolar range is enabling the development of novel therapies and diagnostics and has the potential to identify early-stage disease markers before symptoms appear.

Our instruments are designed to be used either with assays fully developed by us, including all antibodies and supplies required to run the assays, or with "homebrew" assay kits where we supply some of the components required for testing, and the customer supplies the remaining required elements. Accordingly, our installed instruments generate a recurring revenue stream. As the installed base of our instruments increases, we expect total consumables revenue to increase.

We also provide contract research services and clinical laboratory testing services, including four Laboratory Developed Tests ("LDT"), using our proprietary Simoa and Spatial Biology technology through our Accelerator Laboratory which is certified under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 ("CLIA") (the "Accelerator Laboratory"). To date, we have completed over 2,600 projects for more than 500 customers from all over the world using our platforms.

We have an extensive base of worldwide customers including research laboratories, contract research organizations ("CROs"), academic institutions, and bio-pharmaceutical companies. We sell our instruments, consumables, and services through a direct field sales and support organizations in North America and Europe, and through our own sales force and distributors in additional countries, including Australia, Brazil, China, Czech Republic, India, Hong Kong, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United Arab Emirates.

Our total revenues were $138.9 million and $137.4 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. Since our inception, we have incurred annual net losses, including net losses of $107.2 million and $38.5 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
We expect to incur operating losses into 2026 as we incur costs related to:

•expanding our research and development efforts to improve our existing, or to develop and launch, new assays and instruments. These expenses could be particularly significant if any of our products become subject to additional or more burdensome regulation by the U.S Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA");
•investing in Lucent Diagnostics, additional laboratory developed tests ("LDTs"), and other diagnostics initiatives including entry into translational pharma and clinical diagnostic markets;

•seeking Premarket Approval ("PMA"), de novo classification, or 510(k) clearance from the FDA for our existing or new products, including new assays and instruments, if or when we decide to market products for use in the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of a disease or other condition;
•strategically acquiring and integrating companies or technologies that may be complementary to our business;
•making required earnout payments under the Emission, Inc. ("Emission") acquisition agreement, which are contingent upon the achievement of certain performance milestones;

paragraphs: 本公司為生命科學公司，透過我們超敏的轉譯研究與空間生物學儀器、消耗品與服務，加速生物標記的創新從發現到診斷，轉變醫療創新。我們持續投資以推動醫療保健從強調後期治療轉向早期檢測、監測、預測及最終預防的模式。我們的整合平台已實現顯著的商業採用，擁有超過 2,500 臺儀器的安裝基礎，並在神經學、腫瘤學、免疫學及發炎等高未滿足醫療需求與研究興趣領域，獲得超過 6,200 篇科學論文的引用認證。
我們的專利數位「Simoa」檢測技術，使客戶能可靠地在血液、血清及其他液體中偵測蛋白質生物標記，其濃度在許多情況下，使用傳統的類比免疫分析技術是無法偵測的。透過我們的「空間生物學」平台對組織樣本進行多重生物標記分析，使科學家能瞭解細胞層面的局部互動。我們相信我們的技術組合將使科學家在醫療保健領域的發展中，透過組織至液體的連續數據，推動診斷創新。

我們將專利的儀器與相關消耗品銷售至全球的研究實驗室、合同研究機構（"CROs"）、學術機構及生物製藥公司。此外，我們透過我們位於馬薩諸塞州伯德德（Bedford, Massachusetts）的加速實驗室（"Accelerator Laboratory"），使用我們專利的技術與平台，提供合同研究服務與臨牀實驗室測試服務，包括四種實驗室自訂測試（"LDTs"），該實驗室已根據 1988 年臨牀實驗室改善修正案（"CLIA"）認證。
在 2025 年第二季，四位新董事加入我們的董事會，同時四位先前董事會成員離任，包括我們的創始科學家 Dr. David Walt。此外，在 2026 年 1 月，Dr. Masoud Toloue 離開公司，Everett Cunningham 成為我們的首席執行官並加入董事會。這些新董事與我們 CEO 的選任程序，反映我們領導層與董事會在科技、商業、空間及診斷專業領域的有意圖強化。

2025 年 7 月 8 日，我們收購了位於馬薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒（Marlborough, Massachusetts）的 Akoya Biosciences, Inc.（"Akoya"），一家生命科學技術公司，透過空間phenotyping的強大力量，提供空間生物學解決方案。空間phenotyping指的是快速發展的技術，使科學家能偵測並繪製整體組織樣本中細胞類型與生物標記的分佈，以單細胞解析度，促進對疾病進展與患者對治療反應的瞭解。Akoya 推廣專利的儀器平台、試劑、軟體與服務，提供從發現到轉譯與臨牀研究及診斷的完整解決方案，進行組織分析與空間phenotyping。

2025 年 1 月 8 日，我們收購了位於德克薩斯州蓋特韋（Georgetown, Texas）的 Emission, Inc.（"Emission"），一家生命科學製造公司。Emission 生產大量、高度均勻的染料包覆磁珠，用於低至中多重試劑盒，並有一個中多重平台讀取其專利的磁珠。此交易確保 Emission 高度控制的磁珠在我們下一代平台的使用，並拓展至一個新的多重領域，目標為第三方原廠設備製造商客戶。
如需進一步資訊關於 Akoya 與 Emission 的收購，請參閱年度財務報表附註中的第 3 註 - 收購，包含於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度的財務報表與補充資料，位於本 10-K 年度報告的 "Part II, Item 8. 財務報表與補充資料" 節中。
2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們向美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）提交了多分析物演算法血液測試用於阿爾茨海默症（"AD"）的 510(k) 前市通知。

此份申報為本公司履行提供優越、非侵入性、高性能診斷工具之使命的重要里程碑，用以協助評估具認知症狀之患者是否可能罹患阿爾茨海默症。我們的多分析物檢測先前已獲得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）頒發的突破性醫療器材設計認定，此計畫旨在加速具更有效治療或診斷致命或不可逆癱瘓疾病之醫療器材之開發與審查。若本檢測獲得FDA核准，將有助於識別具認知症狀之患者是否可能具有腦部β-胺基酸斑塊——阿爾茨海默症的標誌，透過非侵入性血液檢測提供診斷明確性。
2025年11月，美國醫療保險與醫療援助署（"CMS"）核准我們的LucentAD Complete多分析物檢測項目每項費用為897美元。此里程碑提供一個全國性認可的參考價格，對保險機構的覆蓋決策具有重要意義，促進更廣泛的使用，並支持將此多分析物診斷解決方案引入全美各醫院與實驗室。此外，根據現有資料，我們認為LucentAD Complete有潛力取得地方覆蓋決定，以支持更一致的費用報銷。

如先前披露，我們於2025年8月4日與Kent Lake PR LLC（Kent Lake Partners LP之普通合夥人，合稱"Kent Lake"）簽訂合作協議（"合作協議"），根據協議，我們同意聘請一位高階人才搜尋機構以尋找潛在候選人，以任命為本公司董事會（"董事會"）成員。我們亦同意與Kent Lake合作，從該高階人才搜尋機構提供的六位候選人中選出一位，並於2025年12月1日任命為Class I董事。2025年11月20日，董事會任命兩位新董事，包括一位新任Class I董事。
同時根據合作協議，我們在2025年股東年會上取得股東批准，修改本公司重組後的章程，使董事會去分級化，並修改公司章程，採用多數投票標準進行非競爭性董事選舉，競爭性董事選舉則採用過半數投票標準。
根據合作協議，Kent Lake同意遵守某些投票承諾、慣例靜默義務及雙方不貶低對方的義務，並無訴訟條款，直至根據章程規定的2027年股東年會董事候選人提名截止日期前30日，除非合作協議根據其條款提前終止。

蛋白質是一種多功能的巨分子，參與幾乎所有生物過程的關鍵功能。蛋白質是高度相關的生理分析物，能提供疾病實時的影像，研究人員與臨牀醫學人員廣泛依賴蛋白質生物標記，用於研究及作為臨牀與診斷工具。然而，許多蛋白質的正常生理濃度無法透過傳統的類比免疫分析技術在易取得的血液樣本中檢測到，且許多技術只能在蛋白質濃度達到反映更進展疾病或傷害的水平時才能檢測到。對於許多其他低豐度蛋白質，這些技術甚至無法在疾病或傷害升高濃度時檢測到蛋白質。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析提供資訊，本公司認為與瞭解 Quanterix Corporation 的財務狀況及營運成果相關，針對 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日所終結之會計年度。為完整了解本公司財務狀況及營運成果，應配合閱讀本年度報告表 10-K 中標題為「第二部分，第 8 項。財務報表與補充資料」所附之合併財務報表及相關附註。某些欄位與列數可能因使用四捨五入之數字而無法相加。百分比係根據未四捨五入之基礎數字計算。除歷史資訊外，以下討論與分析包含涉及風險、不確定性與假設之預測性陳述。本公司實際之結果、表現或經驗可能因多項重要因素、風險與不確定性而與下文所述有重大差異，包括但不限於本年度報告表 10-K 中標題為「第一部分，第 1A 項。風險因素」及「預測性陳述之說明」所列之因素。除非文意另有要求，否則本年度報告表 10-K 中之「Quanterix」、「本公司」、「我們」、「它」、「我們」及「我們」均指 Quanterix Corporation 及其合併子公司。
本公司財務狀況於 2024 年 12 月 31 日之狀況，以及 2024 年 12 月 31 日所終結會計年度之營運成果與 2023 年 12 月 31 日所終結會計年度之比較，已包含於本年度報告表 10-K 中標題為「第二部分，第 7 項。管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」之部分，該部分於 2025 年 3 月 17 日向美國證券交易委員會（「SEC」）提交。
本公司為生命科學公司，透過我們超敏的轉譯研究與空間生物學儀器、消耗品與服務，加速生物標記的突破從發現至診斷，從而轉變醫療創新。我們持續投資於推動醫療保健從強調晚期治療轉向早期檢測、監測、預測及最終預防的模式。我們的整合平台已取得顯著的商業採用，安裝基礎逾 2,500 臺儀器，並在神經學、腫瘤學、免疫學及發炎等高未滿足醫療需求與研究興趣領域，透過超過 6,200 篇科學論文之引用取得科學驗證。

我們專利的數位「Simoa」檢測技術，使客戶能可靠地在血液、血清及其他液體中偵測蛋白質生物標記，其濃度在許多情況下，使用傳統的類比免疫分析技術是無法偵測的。透過我們的「空間生物學」平台對組織樣本進行多重生物標記分析，使科學家能瞭解細胞層面上的局部互動。我們相信我們的技術組合將使科學家能協助推動診斷創新，於醫療保健的演進環境中，透過組織至液體連續體的數據推動診斷創新。目前，我們的 Simoa 平台能偵測皮摩爾範圍的蛋白質，使新型療法與診斷的開發成為可能，並有潛力在症狀出現前識別早期疾病標記。
我們的儀器設計為可與我們完全開發的試劑盒搭配使用，包括執行試劑盒所需的所有抗體與耗材，或與「自製」試劑盒搭配使用，其中我們提供部分試劑盒所需的零組件，而客戶則提供其餘所需元件。因此，我們安裝的儀器產生持續性收入。隨著我們儀器安裝基礎的增加，我們預期總消耗品收入將增加。
我們亦提供合同研究服務與臨牀實驗室測試服務，包括四種實驗室自訂測試（「LDT」），透過我們專利的 Simoa 與空間生物學技術，透過我們經認證的加速實驗室（「加速實驗室」），該實驗室符合 1988 年臨牀實驗室改善修正案（「CLIA」）的規定。截至目前為止，我們已為來自世界各地超過 500 家客戶完成超過 2,600 個專案，使用我們的平台。
我們擁有廣泛的全球客戶羣，包括研究實驗室、合同研究機構（「CROs」）、學術機構與生物製藥公司。我們透過直接的現場銷售與支援組織在北美與歐洲銷售我們的儀器、消耗品與服務，並透過我們自己的銷售團隊與經銷商在其他國家銷售，包括澳洲、巴西、中國、捷克共和國、印度、香港、以色列、日本、紐西蘭、卡達、沙特阿拉伯、新加坡、南非、韓國、臺灣與阿拉伯聯合大公國。
我們的總營收為 2025 年 12 月 31 日終結會計年度為 138.9 百萬美元，2024 年 12 月 31 日終結會計年度為 137.4 百萬美元。自我們成立以來，我們已產生年度淨虧損，包括 2025 年 12 月 31 日終結會計年度淨虧損為 107.2 百萬美元，2024 年 12 月 31 日終結會計年度淨虧損為 38.5 百萬美元。
我們預期將在2026年之前持續產生營運虧損，因為我們將產生與以下事項相關的成本：
•擴展我們的研究與開發努力，以改善現有產品，或開發並推出新試劑與儀器。這些費用可能特別顯著，如果我們的任何產品受到美國食品藥物管理局（the "FDA"）額外或更嚴苛的規範；
•投資於Lucent Diagnostics、額外的實驗室自訂檢測（"LDTs"）及其他診斷計畫，包括進入轉譯藥物與臨牀診斷市場；
•向美國食品藥物管理局（the "FDA"）尋求現行產品或新產品（包括新試劑與儀器）的上市前批准（"PMA"）、新類別分類（de novo classification）或510(k)認可，如果或當我們決定將產品用於預防、診斷或治療疾病或其他狀況；
•戰略性地收購並整合可能與我們業務具有補充性的公司或技術；
•根據Emission, Inc.（"Emission"）收購協議，支付必要的 earnout 金額，這些金額取決於達成特定績效里程碑。

headings: 與我們財務狀況及財務報導事項相關的風險
自我們成立以來，我們已連續每年產生虧損，且我們預期未來仍可能產生虧損。我們無法確定我們是否能實現或維持獲利。
與我們財務報導內部控制相關的內在限制，可能會導致我們財務報表出現重大錯誤。
我們使用淨營業虧損抵減未來所得的能力可能受到某些限制。
與我們業務相關的風險
我們可能無法實現成本削減行動所預期的剩餘成本節省及相關效益，且這些行動的後果可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
若我們的產品無法實現並維持足夠的市場接受度，將會對我們的營業收入產生負面影響。
我們可能無法成功打入診斷市場。
我們儀器的銷售週期可能長且不固定，這使我們難以預測營業收入及其他營運結果。
我們客戶購買我們儀器需要大量的資金投入，這可能在支出受限時影響銷售。
由於我們營業收入的很大一部分來自少數大型客戶，若因產業整合或其他原因導致這些客戶銷售大幅減少，可能影響我們的營運結果。
我們的長期表現取決於我們改善現有產品並成功且及時推出與行銷新產品的能力。
我們可能在預期時間表內遭遇延宕，延遲推出與商業化下一代儀器，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生負面影響。
我們對海外銷售的依賴程度，可能透過經銷商影響我們的營收。
我們可能因違反美國反貪污法及其他全球反賄賂法律，而遭受負面影響，無論是我們或我們代理人所為。
生醫科學研究及診斷市場競爭激烈。若我們無法有效競爭，將會影響本公司營運成果、財務狀況及營運績效。
整合任何我們取得的業務、產品或技術可能耗費大量成本與時間，並可能幹擾及不利影響我們持續進行的業務，包括產品銷售，並分散我們管理階層的注意力。
與政府規範及診斷產品給付相關的風險
本公司產品未來可能遭召回，此情形可能損害本公司聲譽、業務及財務表現。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素及其他資訊包含於本年度報告表 10-K 中，應謹慎考量。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為較不重要，也可能影響我們的業務運作。請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 ii 頁，以瞭解部分受這些風險因素限制的前瞻性陳述。若上述任何風險發生，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與未來成長前景造成重大且不利的影響。
•我們過去的季度與年度營運結果與現金流有所波動，未來可能持續波動，這可能會導致我們普通股的價值波動或顯著下跌。
•自我們成立以來，我們已產生年度虧損，並預期未來仍會產生虧損。我們無法確定我們是否能達成或維持獲利。
•與我們財務報導內部控制相關的內在限制，可能會導致我們財務報表出現重大錯誤。
•將我們的業務與 Akoya 結合可能比預期更困難、成本更高或耗時更久，我們可能無法實現該併購預期的剩餘效益，這可能會對我們的業務結果造成不利影響，並對我們普通股的價值產生負面影響。
•我們可能無法實現成本削減行動預期的剩餘節省與相關效益，而這些行動的後果可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
